notes: Crystal is not described as automatic; the page does not give the threshold, a validity period for status reached this way, or a programme end date.
summary: Official programme page (launched July 14, 2026). After linking accounts, Marriott members receive FLY ON Points each year by tier: Titanium 30,000 and Ambassador 40,000, and those two tiers earn Crystal or higher according to accumulated FLY ON Points. Points arrive within about 6 weeks of linking and then each spring. One JAL account links to one Marriott account and the link cannot be changed. Benefits depend on Marriott status on the registration day and, in later years, on the status then held.
title: JAL Mileage Bank & Marriott Bonvoy, Status Match Starts
